scenario: Companion-slot sugar per LSER.10.6 — `t.mean` desugars to `mean(<slot>)` at validate time. Pin: a `series Sensor.state:` declaring `mean sliding 10_s`, and a rule reading `t.mean`, compile. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowered defrule, so the lowering is not observed.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    mean sliding 10_s

rule alert_high_avg:
    Sensor t where t.mean > 50
->
    log info "x"
